content:
Changes the role for the specified user.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The unique ID of the user whose role you want to change.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
Array of strings <uuid>
= 1 items
The UUID of the role to assign to the user.
Note: Although the role UUID is defined within an array, you can only provide
one role UUID.
